commits.body:
Replayed the four disputed public callers on the current Maven releases and frozen upstream development commits. The same caller bytecode confirmed the Avro array-default and jOOλ window defects on release and development builds, and the ical4j override-order defect on its development branch. Three public reproductions and related tracker checks are ready for the user in VF-065. Jackson's documented wrapping and the independent token reader both preserved both rows on all four tested deployments, correcting the brief's two-row configuration assumption.

All 34 release and development observations and four historical Jackson controls reproduced in clean JVMs. The standalone report instructions reproduced the release behavior for every affected module. The four changed examples plus HikariCP and JDT passed their normal replay validators, incorrect artifact digests and class providers were rejected, the pipeline layout validated, and all 54 selected test suites passed. The five previous campaign jobs passed. Job 20261125-095857-replay-three-upstream-defects-and-the-ja independently repeats these 38 observations and the original 143-JVM campaign.
